stem: Which question is most appropriate if you want to assess brief resolved unexplained event (BRUE) definition and risk classification?

options.text: A question asking whether BRUE appears in the General Paediatrics section
A question asking for a BRUE definition and risk classification
A question asking which unrelated topic is discussed on page 20
A question asking whether the notes include a contents section
A question asking if obesity assessment is discussed in the notes

explanation: BRUE definition and risk classification is the correct focus. It tests the intended clinical concept directly and remains clinically grounded.

citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because this asks about document structure rather than the BRUE clinical concept
optionExplanations.B: Correct because it directly assesses BRUE definition and risk classification
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because it is an unrelated metadata question and does not assess BRUE
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because it asks about the presence of a contents section rather than BRUE
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because it concerns obesity assessment, not BRUE
